localChangeWindow.status: NEW PROVISIONAL local cycle only; not global calendar/Shardspire/primordial conversion
localChangeWindow.anchor: The cooling bell marks END of each 40-minute open window. Windows recur every 12 world-hours from opening start to next opening start. Therefore after a cooling bell, the next opening begins 11h20m later.

values.coldReference: 10 minutes before opening: surface 92°F; unloaded reference-groove offset 0.0 mm; PAIR/QUIET indicators dark because regulator is IDLE.
values.openingStart: minute 0: surface 104°F; unloaded reference-groove offset +0.2 mm; wax amber rod softens.
values.midWindow: minute20: surface112°F; unloaded reference-groove offset+0.4mm; amber/white/black rods are soft (their opening offsets are0/10/20minutes respectively); luminous PAIR/QUIET remain dark when IDLE.
values.windowClose: minute 40 cooling bell: surface 100°F; reference-groove offset +0.1 mm; rods begin reharden.
values.post: 20 minutes after close: surface 94°F; reference-groove offset 0.0 mm.

localChangeWindow.separationFromLoadedResonance: These temperature/reference-groove values are environmental calibration drift. Luminous PAIR A/B positions exist only during a deliberate loaded regulator test and must never be inferred from the idle heat drift.

partyObservation.pre: Observe continuously from10minutes before the opening through its start using the fixed marked temperature/reference gauge. Record PRE-n:92°F/0.0mm then104°F/+0.2mm.
partyObservation.post: Continue through minute20 (112°F/+0.4mm), close at40 (100°F/+0.1mm), and20minutes after close (94°F/0.0mm). This full70minute observation records POST-n; IDLE luminous indicators remain dark.
partyObservation.duration: 70 actual minutes from -10 to +60 relative to opening; active observation cannot overlap another research block, rest, travel or guard.

partyObservation.fixtures: The alcove has a fixed engraved temperature scale and0.1mm reference gauge; these NEW observation fixtures provide the printed readings and are not free portable item-catalogue additions.

localChangeWindow.missedWindow: If the party arrives after the cooling bell without a PRE reading, it cannot create that window’s party pair. Wait for the next opening. Arrival 5 minutes after close leaves exactly 11h15m until next opening.
localChangeWindow.timestampExample: If a cooling bell rings Day R1 08:40:00, the next opening starts Day R1 20:00:00 and closes 20:40:00; the following opening starts Day R2 08:00:00.
localChangeWindow.recovery: Missing/damaging one pair is recoverable by observing a later recurring window; each later window is a genuinely new physical observation identity. No extra window is created by resting, leaving/re-entering, or renaming the site.

maintainedSeparation.start: Authenticated IDLE; maintenance catch released; plate seated; captive keeper unseated; separation control set to two-groove hold.
maintainedSeparation.initiation: LOAD lever: one Action / 6 seconds. Define pulse second 0 at completion of that Action.
maintainedSeparation.end: At pulse second60 BEGIN ABORT/RETURN; outside initiative its6seconds complete at66. Only at completion is IDLE restored and the10-minute LOAD lockout started. controlledRelease.start: Begin from the authenticated maintained-separation loaded state PAIR A=3 / PAIR B=1 / QUIET dark / keeper 1/3.
controlledRelease.releaseAction: Release separation control: one Action / 6 seconds. Define controlled-release second 0 at completion.

observations.condition: If no timely ABORT resolves, captive keeper seats and QUIET LOCK begins.

controlledRelease.abortDeadline: Outside initiative begin the6second ABORT no later than second36. It completes by42 and resolves before lock at that exact timestamp. In initiative announce the cue before the operator's regular turn at the corresponding30second boundary; allow the actual Action and resolve it before the42second lock boundary. Each genuinely later operation retains its own actual action legality and any KT3 episode save; no reaction or free extra Action is granted.
controlledRelease.successfulAbort: PAIR channels decay toward IDLE, keeper retracts, 10-minute local lockout begins, and all observations already made remain valid.
controlledRelease.ignoredAbort: If ABORT has not completed by controlled-release second42, resolve any timely completed ABORT first; otherwise captive keeper seats and QUIET LOCK disables LOAD/maintenance access for10minutes. At lock expiry the fixture vents/retracts to IDLE. No force damage, Hunt, PT or protected Pact effect is added. Objects deliberately inserted remain where the actual fixture holds them until access is restored; no unique loot respawns.
controlledRelease.preload: From IDLE after lockout, LOAD costs one Action/6seconds outside initiative. Observe12loaded seconds until A=3/B=1 is verified, then RELEASE costs one Action/6seconds. Controlled-release second0 is RELEASE completion. Do not silently preload or count both actions as one.
